record.question:
With reference to industrial region in India, consider the following statements:
      (i) Cotton textile industry has a long history in the Mumbai–Pune industrial region.
     (ii) Kolkata–Hooghly industrial region is famous for jute production.
    (iii) Gurugram–Delhi–Meerut industrial region has been rapidly developing in recent years.
    Which of the statements given above are correct?
